scope: Workspace hierarchy, drawing controls, object inspector, responsive layouts, and calculation presentation
reviewer: Implementation agent self-review, not independent review

meaning_review.geometry: Course force, moment, support, joint, and member geometry is unchanged. Global and local axes remain visible. Reaction annotation text uses darker gold for contrast; reaction arrows retain the course colour.
meaning_review.calculations: The same symbolic and numeric equations now appear in grouped derivation steps, with a separate evaluation area. No solver, proof source, input value, or rounding rule changed.
meaning_review.interactions: Focus view hides the side panels without changing the model, camera scale, or selected tool. Escape restores the panels. At narrower widths a Properties button scrolls to the selected object's inspector.
meaning_review.practice: Problem mode continues to hide numerical results and collapse the worked solution until an explicit reveal.
meaning_review.cache: The build fingerprints application stylesheet URLs, preventing mixed old and new layouts. A previously broad reaction-span selector is restricted to its immediate wrapper, preserving KaTeX layout.

readability_review: The new presentation stylesheet is grouped by navigation, tools, drawing, results, calculations, and responsive behaviour. Focus and navigation handlers have explicit state updates. Existing IDs and numerical interfaces are retained.

validation.automated: Type checking and all 35 Node tests passed. All 987 public equations, including 960 symbolic forms, rendered without errors and retained their proof hashes. Static build and whitespace checks passed.
validation.desktop: Reviewed the grouped palette, selected load inspector, support reactions, focus toggle, Escape restoration, and two-column derivation steps. Reaction rows now render inline instead of stacking their mathematical symbols.
validation.responsive: Checked 390 x 844 and 1024 x 900 viewports, then restored the original viewport. No page overflow or math-render errors were found. Mobile derivation steps stack in one column and object-property fields fill their panel.
validation.privacy: Tests used a temporary preview port and synthetic examples. User models and student records were not replaced. Local Lean execution remained disabled.
